sourceHtml:
NVIDIA RTX Spark powers thin and light laptops built for everything that developers, creators and gamers do.

RTX Spark laptops are now available from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI. These powerful systems combine an NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU and an NVIDIA Grace CPU in a single superchip with up to 128GB of unified memory and up to 1 petaflop of FP4 AI performance. That puts the NVIDIA CUDA platform, RTX graphics and the capabilities of a personal AI supercomputer inside premium Windows laptops built to go anywhere.

New and expected RTX Spark updates, coming soon, include:

  • NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe, an open weight speech model for transcription, speaker attribution and translation is available on RTX Spark. 
  • The LFM3 family of open models with day-zero support. 
  • Resource management controls in NVIDIA App to allocate GPU resources between foreground apps and background agents.
  • Phantom Blade Zero, S-GAME’s highly-anticipated action role-playing game, launches with ray tracing and NVIDIA DLSS 4.5.
  • Experience Minecraft with path tracing and DLSS with RTX Remix1.6, available now for RTX Spark.

Turn Recorded Audio Into Useful Information With NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe

Introduced today, NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe is a new, open weight speech model that turns recorded conversations into useful information. Instead of needing multiple models for transcription, speaker labels and translation, developers can use one promptable model that handles all three, plus questions about the audio. It transcribes 40 languages, including seven Indic languages.

Developers guide the model with plain-language prompts. For example, for a single recorded meeting, users can ask it to:

  • “Transcribe this recording and label each speaker.”
  • “Translate this audio into English.”
  • “List what decisions were made in this meeting.”

Prompts can also include product terms and formatting conventions, which helps the model handle specialized vocabulary in fields like healthcare, financial services and customer service. Because the weights are open, developers can choose where audio is processed, from a desktop to the cloud.

Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe ranks No. 1 on the Hugging Face Open ASR and No. 2 among open weight models on Artificial Analysis — delivering leading accuracy with approximately 4.3 billion active parameters, 80% fewer than the No. 1 open weight model, making high-quality, intelligent transcription more practical on local hardware.

It’s available today on Hugging Face. Quantized versions are coming soon, so  developers can run Transcribe locally onNVIDIA RTX Spark and DGX Spark systems, Jetson AGX Thor devices or scale up on NVIDIA Blackwell data center GPUs. NVFP4 versions will be deployable through NeMo-Speech.cpp or vLLM.

Learn more in the NVIDIA technical blog.

Control How Agents and PC Apps Share GPU Resources

On RTX Spark, users can have long-running agents working alongside their favorite applications. Both share the system’s GPU compute, and the right balance of resources depends on what matters to users at that moment.

With the new resource management feature in NVIDIA App, users can now choose how GPU resources are shared. They can prioritize their foreground app for the best performance, or give their background-running agent more resources to get work done faster. 

Access control resource sharing from System > Advanced in the NVIDIA App. This feature requires hardware-accelerated GPU scheduling to be enabled in Windows Settings.

Liquid AI: One Model Family, Many Ways to Work

Liquid AI’s LFM3 provides a new generation of Liquid Foundation Models designed for specialized tasks. The family spans text, vision, audio, omni and decision models built on one shared backbone, with base and post-trained models available as open weights. The models are compact and fast: Liquid AI’s new 1.7-billion-parameter base model outperforms its previous 2.6-billion-parameter base model.

These models support local workflows such as agents running in Hermes Agent, Pi and OpenClaw to triage inboxes and manage calendars, read documents and app screens, transcribe and translate speech, answer spoken questions about handwritten math, and route support tickets or voice requests. 

Developers can run LFM3 models on RTX Spark with native support through llama.cpp and vLLM, and fine-tune the models locally.

‘Phantom Blade Zero’ Launches With DLSS 4.5

S-GAME’s Phantom Blade Zero launches tonight, Oct. 28, at 7 p.m. PT on Steam and the Epic Games Store. Players can take on the role of Soul, a swordsman framed for his master’s murder, as he travels the martial world to uncover a conspiracy.

NVIDIA worked with S-GAME Studio and S-GAME Publishing to add ray-traced effects to the title. On RTX Spark laptops and GeForce RTX GPU-powered PCs, ray tracing adds more accurate bounced lighting, detailed reflections and realistic shadows on foliage and terrain. The NVIDIA DLSS Dynamic Multi Frame Generation feature boosts frame rates with up to 6x frame generation, or adjusts the multiplier on the fly to hit a player’s target frame rate.

Read more on GeForce.com.

RTX Remix Breathes New Life Into Classics 

NVIDIA RTX Remix, the modding platform for remastering classic games with path tracing and DLSS, released version 1.6 last week. This update brought RTX Remix to the world’s largest gaming community: Minecraft. Both creators and players can render Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.1 through RTX Remix with DLSS-accelerated path tracing and take full advantage of realistic lighting and materials in their future creations.

The update also adds DLSS 5 with 3D-Guided Neural Rendering, up to 6x Multi Frame Generation, native RTX Spark support and agent-assisted workflows. Starting today, those upgrades come to Portal with RTX and the Half-Life 2 RTX demo. Both now support RTX Spark, with DLSS 3D-Guided Neural Rendering for more lifelike lighting and materials, a new Performance Mode for DLSS Frame Generation and new options that speed up path tracing. 

RTX Remix 1.6 also makes AI-powered modding simpler. A redesigned ComfyUI workflow lets modders generate physically based materials directly inside RTX Remix, with no application programming interface setup, batch processing for full projects and presets for less technical creators. Plus, with NVIDIA agent skills, compatible AI agents can work directly with RTX Remix to help speed up remastering projects.

Learn more in the RTX Remix blog. 

RTX Spark Laptops: Beautifully Designed, Built for Everything

RTX Spark laptops come in a range of designs, so users can choose one that fits how they work and play. Options include different screen sizes, colors, touchscreens, pen support and two-in-one convertibles. RTX Spark laptops are as thin as 14mm and as light as three pounds, with all-day battery life.

Such slim designs are possible because RTX Spark places the GPU, CPU and up to 128GB of unified memory on one power-efficient superchip. Creative projects and AI models draw from the same memory pool, so a laptop can take on work that used to call for a desktop workstation, even when unplugged. 

Here’s what this means for:

  • AI developers: Run models and agents locally on NVIDIA CUDA — the same platform that powers AI in the cloud — with a path to deploy across more than 150 million NVIDIA RTX AI PCs and NVIDIA GPUs in the cloud.
  • Creators: RTX Spark can edit camera native 4:2:2 video and render 3D scenes of up to 90GB. Adobe Photoshop and Premiere offer native RTX Spark support through beta releases.
  • Gamers: Hundreds of games run on RTX Spark, with NVIDIA DLSS, ray tracing, Reflex and G-SYNC delivering sharper visuals and smoother, more responsive gameplay.

RTX Spark laptops are available now from ASUS, Dell, HP, Lenovo, Microsoft and MSI, starting at $2,599, with 128GB configurations on shelves. Find a laptop on the RTX Spark product page.

#ICYMI: More Updates From NVIDIA Local AI

🦆Microducks learn to walk with help from RTX Spark: During the GTC Berlin keynote, NVIDIA founder and CEO Jensen Huang showed how AI agents running on RTX Spark can help train Hugging Face’s Microduck robot. A new NVIDIA technical blog walks through the workflow: Hermes Agent and Nemotron 3.5 Bolt plan an obstacle course on RTX Spark, Astra builds the 3D assets, NVIDIA Isaac Lab trains the navigation policy and RTX Spark validates it in NVIDIA Isaac Sim. Watch the demo and try the playbook.

⚡NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB is now available, enabling natural conversations and multistep agent tasks with as little as 4GB of memory. The model powers local voice assistants, game characters and embedded interfaces on RTX Spark, DGX Spark, GeForce RTX GPUs and NVIDIA Jetson devices. It supports llama.cpp, vLLM, Ollama, Unsloth and LM Studio, and works with Hermes and OpenClaw. For more demanding agent workloads, Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB is designed to run local agents on RTX Spark.

🖼️Black Forest Labs’ FLUX 3 Image Klein is a 5.6-billion-parameter open weights model that lets users generate and edit images locally. NVIDIA-optimized versions run on RTX GPUs with as little as 8GB of VRAM. Developers can also fine-tune the model on RTX Spark using an NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel recipe to customize it for specific creative workflows.

🖥️NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB is now available to purchase from manufacturer partners, giving developers and researchers another way to build and run AI locally. Powered by the GB10 Grace Blackwell Superchip, it combines 64GB of unified memory with DGX OS and the NVIDIA AI software stack for agent development, inference and fine-tuning. Learn more and explore purchase options.

Follow NVIDIA RTX Spark on X, Instagram, TikTok and Facebook — and stay informed by subscribing to the NVIDIA Local AI newsletter. Follow NVIDIA Workstation on LinkedIn and X. 

See notice regarding software product information.

translation.html:
NVIDIA RTX Spark 为轻薄笔记本电脑提供强大动力，满足开发者、创作者和游戏玩家的各种需求。

ASUS、Dell、HP、Lenovo、Microsoft 和 MSI 现已推出 RTX Spark 笔记本电脑。这些高性能系统将 NVIDIA Blackwell RTX GPU 和 NVIDIA Grace CPU 集成在一颗超级芯片中，配备最高 128GB 的统一内存，提供最高 1 petaflop 的 FP4 AI 算力。这让 NVIDIA CUDA 平台、RTX 图形技术以及个人 AI 超级计算机的能力融入了便于随身携带的高端 Windows 笔记本电脑。

即将推出的 RTX Spark 新更新和预期更新包括：

  • NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 现已支持 RTX Spark，这是一款用于转录、说话人归属识别和翻译的开放权重语音模型。 
  • LFM3 开放模型系列在发布首日即获支持。 
  • NVIDIA App 中的资源管理控件，可在前台应用与后台智能体之间分配 GPU 资源。
  • 《影之刃零》是 S-GAME 备受期待的动作角色扮演游戏，将在发售时支持光线追踪和 NVIDIA DLSS 4.5。
  • 通过现已支持 RTX Spark 的 RTX Remix 1.6，体验具备路径追踪和 DLSS 的《我的世界》。

使用 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 将录音转化为有用信息

今天推出的 NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 是一款全新的开放权重语音模型，可将录制的对话转化为有用信息。开发者无需分别使用多个模型完成转录、说话人标注和翻译，只需使用一个可通过提示词控制的模型，即可完成这三项任务，并回答有关音频的问题。它支持 40 种语言的转录，其中包括七种印度语言。

开发者可通过自然语言提示词引导模型。例如，对于同一段会议录音，用户可以要求它：

  • “转录这段录音，并标注每位说话人。”
  • “将这段音频翻译成英语。”
  • “列出这次会议做出的决策。”

提示词还可以包含产品术语和格式规范，帮助模型处理医疗保健、金融服务和客户服务等领域的专业词汇。由于权重开放，开发者可以选择在桌面电脑或云端等不同环境中处理音频。

Nemotron 3.5 Transcribe 在 Hugging Face Open ASR 上排名第 1，在 Artificial Analysis 的开放权重模型中排名第 2。它仅用约 43 亿激活参数就实现了领先的准确率，参数量比排名第 1 的开放权重模型少 80%，让在本地硬件上进行高质量智能转录更加切实可行。

该模型今天已在 Hugging Face 上推出。量化版本即将发布，届时开发者可在 NVIDIA RTX Spark 和 DGX Spark 系统、Jetson AGX Thor 设备上本地运行 Transcribe，也可在 NVIDIA Blackwell 数据中心 GPU 上扩大运行规模。NVFP4 版本将可通过 NeMo-Speech.cpp 或 vLLM 部署。

更多信息请参阅 NVIDIA 技术博客。

控制智能体和 PC 应用如何共享 GPU 资源

在 RTX Spark 上，用户可以让长时间运行的智能体与自己喜爱的应用同时工作。两者共享系统的 GPU 计算资源，而合适的资源分配比例取决于用户当下的侧重点。

借助 NVIDIA App 中新增的资源管理功能，用户现在可以选择如何共享 GPU 资源。他们可以优先为前台应用分配资源，以获得最佳性能，也可以为后台运行的智能体分配更多资源，让它更快地完成工作。 

可在 NVIDIA App 的“系统 > 高级”中访问资源共享控制。使用此功能需要先在 Windows 设置中启用硬件加速 GPU 调度。

Liquid AI：一个模型系列，多种工作方式

Liquid AI 的 LFM3 带来了专为特定任务设计的新一代 Liquid Foundation Models。该系列基于同一个共享骨干架构，涵盖文本、视觉、音频、全模态和决策模型，并开放基础模型与后训练模型的权重。这些模型小巧且快速：Liquid AI 全新的 17 亿参数基础模型，性能超过其上一代 26 亿参数基础模型。

这些模型支持多种本地工作流程，例如让在 Hermes Agent、Pi 和 OpenClaw 中运行的智能体对收件箱内容进行分类处理并管理日历、阅读文档和应用界面、转录和翻译语音、回答有关手写数学内容的口头提问，以及分派客服工单或语音请求。 

开发者可以借助 llama.cpp 和 vLLM 的原生支持，在 RTX Spark 上运行 LFM3 模型，并在本地对模型进行微调。

《影之刃零》发售时将支持 DLSS 4.5

S-GAME 的《影之刃零》将于今晚，即太平洋时间 10 月 28 日晚上 7 点，在 Steam 和 Epic Games Store 发售。玩家将扮演被诬陷杀害师父的剑客“魂”，闯荡武林，揭开一场阴谋。

NVIDIA 与 S-GAME Studio 和 S-GAME Publishing 合作，为这款游戏加入了光线追踪效果。在 RTX Spark 笔记本电脑和搭载 GeForce RTX GPU 的 PC 上，光线追踪可带来更准确的反弹光照、更细致的反射，以及植被和地形上更逼真的阴影。NVIDIA DLSS 动态多帧生成功能可通过最高 6 倍帧生成提高帧率，也可实时调整倍数，以达到玩家设定的目标帧率。

更多内容请访问 GeForce.com。

RTX Remix 为经典游戏注入新生 

NVIDIA RTX Remix 是一个利用路径追踪和 DLSS 对经典游戏进行重制的模组制作平台，上周发布了 1.6 版本。此次更新将 RTX Remix 带到了全球最大的游戏社区：《我的世界》。创作者和玩家均可通过 RTX Remix 渲染《我的世界 Java 版 1.21.1》，使用 DLSS 加速的路径追踪，并在今后的创作中充分利用逼真的光照和材质。

此次更新还加入了具备 3D 引导神经渲染的 DLSS 5、最高 6 倍多帧生成、RTX Spark 原生支持以及智能体辅助工作流程。从今天起，这些升级将登陆 《Portal with RTX》 和 《Half-Life 2 RTX》 演示版。两者现在都支持 RTX Spark，并提供 DLSS 3D 引导神经渲染，让光照和材质更加逼真，同时加入 DLSS 帧生成的全新性能模式，以及加速路径追踪的新选项。 

RTX Remix 1.6 还简化了 AI 驱动的模组制作。重新设计的 ComfyUI 工作流程让模组作者无需配置应用程序编程接口，即可直接在 RTX Remix 内生成基于物理的材质，并支持对整个项目进行批量处理，还为技术经验较少的创作者提供了预设。此外，借助 NVIDIA 智能体技能，兼容的 AI 智能体可以直接与 RTX Remix 协作，帮助加快重制项目的进度。

更多信息请参阅 RTX Remix 博客。 

RTX Spark 笔记本电脑：精美设计，满足多种需求

RTX Spark 笔记本电脑提供多种设计，用户可以根据自己的工作和娱乐方式进行选择。可选配置包括不同的屏幕尺寸、颜色、触摸屏、手写笔支持以及二合一可翻转机型。RTX Spark 笔记本电脑最薄仅 14mm，最轻仅三磅，并提供全天电池续航。

之所以能实现如此纤薄的设计，是因为 RTX Spark 将 GPU、CPU 和最高 128GB 的统一内存集成在一颗高能效超级芯片上。创意项目和 AI 模型使用同一个内存池，因此即使未接通电源，笔记本电脑也能承担过去需要桌面工作站才能完成的任务。 

这对以下人群意味着：

  • AI 开发者：可在本地通过 NVIDIA CUDA 运行模型和智能体。CUDA 也是为云端 AI 提供支持的平台，并提供了将模型和智能体部署到超过 1.5 亿台 NVIDIA RTX AI PC 以及云端 NVIDIA GPU 的途径。
  • 创作者：RTX Spark 可以剪辑相机原生 4:2:2 视频，并渲染大小最高达 90GB 的 3D 场景。Adobe Photoshop 和 Premiere 通过测试版提供对 RTX Spark 的原生支持。
  • 游戏玩家：数百款游戏可在 RTX Spark 上运行，NVIDIA DLSS、光线追踪、Reflex 和 G-SYNC 带来更清晰的画面，以及更流畅、响应更灵敏的游戏体验。

ASUS、Dell、HP、Lenovo、Microsoft 和 MSI 现已推出 RTX Spark 笔记本电脑，起售价为 2,599 美元，128GB 配置机型也已上架。请前往 RTX Spark 产品页面寻找合适的笔记本电脑。

#ICYMI：NVIDIA 本地 AI 的更多更新

🦆Microduck 在 RTX Spark 的帮助下学习行走：在 GTC 柏林大会主题演讲中，NVIDIA 创始人兼首席执行官黄仁勋展示了在 RTX Spark 上运行的 AI 智能体如何帮助训练 Hugging Face 的 Microduck 机器人。一篇新的 NVIDIA 技术博客详细介绍了这一工作流程：Hermes Agent 和 Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 在 RTX Spark 上规划障碍路线，Astra 构建 3D 资产，NVIDIA Isaac Lab 训练导航策略，RTX Spark 则在 NVIDIA Isaac Sim 中验证该策略。观看演示，并尝试操作指南。

⚡NVIDIA Nemotron 3.5 Bolt E4B 4GB 现已推出，仅需 4GB 内存即可支持自然对话和多步骤智能体任务。该模型可在 RTX Spark、DGX Spark、GeForce RTX GPU 和 NVIDIA Jetson 设备上，为本地语音助手、游戏角色和嵌入式界面提供支持。它支持 llama.cpp、vLLM、Ollama、Unsloth 和 LM Studio，并可与 Hermes 和 OpenClaw 配合使用。对于要求更高的智能体工作负载，Nemotron 3.5 Bolt 74B-A9B 24GB 专为在 RTX Spark 上运行本地智能体而设计。

🖼️Black Forest Labs 的 FLUX 3 Image Klein 是一款拥有 56 亿参数的开放权重模型，让用户能够在本地生成和编辑图像。经 NVIDIA 优化的版本可在显存低至 8GB 的 RTX GPU 上运行。开发者还可以使用 NVIDIA NeMo AutoModel 配方，在 RTX Spark 上对模型进行微调，针对特定创意工作流程进行定制。

🖥️NVIDIA DGX Spark 64GB 现已可通过制造商合作伙伴购买，为开发者和研究人员提供了另一种在本地构建和运行 AI 的方式。它由 GB10 Grace Blackwell 超级芯片驱动，将 64GB 统一内存与 DGX OS 和 NVIDIA AI 软件栈相结合，用于智能体开发、推理和微调。了解更多信息并查看购买选项。

在 X、Instagram、TikTok 和 Facebook 上关注 NVIDIA RTX Spark，并订阅 NVIDIA Local AI 电子简报以获取最新资讯。在 LinkedIn 和 X 上关注 NVIDIA Workstation。 

有关软件产品信息，请参阅声明。
